aboutHeading: 10 Years of Tree Care in Burnside
aboutText: With 10 years of experience, AKR Tree Services provides expert tree care to Burnside and Melbourne's western suburbs. We are based in Burnside and service within a 30km radius, including Keilor, St Albans, and Sunshine. Our team uses professional equipment and is fully licensed and insured for your peace of mind. Contact us to confirm service in your area.
servicesText: From emergency tree removal to routine pruning, AKR Tree Services offers comprehensive solutions for all tree-related needs. With 10 years of experience, we ensure safe and efficient service using professional equipment. Serving Burnside and surrounding areas.
